content.query:
SELECT
	 MRC.BNK_CODE AS BANK_ID
	,DD.CURRENT_MONTH_END AS TXN_DATE
	,MRC.CIF_NO AS CIF_ID
	,MRT.TXN_FIELD1 AS BILLER_ID
	,COUNT(MRT.TXN_ID) AS TXN_COUNT
	,MRT.STATUS AS TXN_STATUS
	,MRT.FROM_ACCT_CCY AS CRNCY_CODE
	,SUM(MRT.TXN_AMT) AS TXN_AMT_ORIG
	,SUM(CASE WHEN MRT.FROM_ACCT_CCY <> 'PHP' THEN MRT.TXN_AMT *  CC.ConversionRate ELSE MRT.TXN_AMT END) AS TXN_AMT_PHP
	,MRT.TXN_TYPE AS TXN_TYPE
	,MRT.TO_BANK_NAME AS RECEIVING_BANK
	,(CASE WHEN MRT.TXN_TYPE = 'Bills Payment (BP/BPQ)' THEN DBD2.GROSS_TXN_FEE
ELSE
DBD1.GROSS_TXN_FEE END) AS GROSS_TXN_FEE
	,(CASE WHEN MRT.TXN_TYPE = 'Bills Payment (BP/BPQ)' THEN DBD2.NET_TXN_FEE
ELSE
DBD1.NET_TXN_FEE END) AS NET_TXN_FEE
	,SUM(TXN_COUNT * GROSS_TXN_FEE) AS GROSS_FEE_INCOME
	,SUM(TXN_COUNT * NET_TXN_FEE) AS NET_FEE_INCOME
	,MRT.SOURCE_CODE AS SOURCE_CODE
	,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS INSERT_DTTM
FROM EDS. MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB MRC
INNER JOIN EDS.MBK_RTBKTRANSACTIONMTB MRT
	ON MRT.CUST_ID = MRC.CUST_ID 
	AND MRT.BNK_CODE = 'CBC01'
INNER JOIN EDS.DATE_DIM DD
	ON MRT.TXN_DATE = DD.FULLDATE
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CurrencyConversion CC
	ON MRT.FROM_ACCT_CCY = CC.ConvertFromCurrencyId 
	AND CC.ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' 
	AND CC.RateId = 'REV' 
	AND CC.FinancialInstitutionId = 'CBC01'
LEFT JOIN EDS.DIGITAL_BILLERS_DIM DBD1
	ON MRT.TXN_TYPE = DBD1.TXN_TYPE
LEFT JOIN EDS.DIGITAL_BILLERS_DIM DBD2
	ON DBD1.BILLER_ID = MRT.TXN_FIELD1 
	AND MRT.TXN_TYPE = 'Bills Payment (BP/BPQ)'	
GROUP BY
	 MRC.BNK_CODE
	,DD.CURRENT_MONTH_END
	,MRC.CIF_NO
	,MRT.TXN_FIELD1
	,MRT.STATUS
	,MRT.FROM_ACCT_CCY
	,MRT.TXN_TYPE
	,MRT.TO_BANK_NAME
	,COALESCE(DBD1.GROSS_TXN_FEE,DBD2.GROSS_TXN_FEE)
	,COALESCE(DBD1.NET_TXN_FEE,DBD2.NET_TXN_FEE)
	,MRT.SOURCE_CODE
